title: Cancer Free Since 2019
content: Cancer Free Since 2019Radical Remission ProjectMay 29, 20241 min readRomy was diagnosed with Stage IV colon cancer in October 2014. In the first 4 years, she had 8 surgeries, 7 recurrences, chemo, and radiation. In her gut, she never actually thought this was going to take her out, but since everyone was telling her it would, she forged ahead. Around the 3-year mark she added in several other modalities to improve her outcome. She really feels that releasing suppressed emotions and having a strong will to live changed her outcome dramatically.
